query: Crea una wiki GitHub per questo repo
expected_behavior: Runs discovery first and presents a content plan listing every page with its audience and its Diataxis quadrant, then waits for confirmation before writing any page
Writes Home.md, _Sidebar.md, _Footer.md and the topic pages as Markdown into the local wiki/ directory and produces nothing outside it
Does not push to the wiki remote, and says the push needs explicit authorisation
The Reference quadrant pages follow the module-guide structure `doc-expert` defines instead of an ad hoc layout

query: La wiki è vecchia, aggiornala dopo che abbiamo aggiunto i nuovi agent
expected_behavior: Diffs the existing wiki against the current source and rewrites only the affected pages instead of regenerating everything

Every file path, command and config key in the updated pages exists in the repo; anything that could not be confirmed carries an inline '> _Needs verification_' marker and also appears in the Stale block
All file output goes through the Write tool, never a Bash heredoc or redirect

query: Ristruttura la wiki, il sidebar è un disastro e i contributor non trovano niente
expected_behavior: Names the Diataxis quadrant of each page explicitly in the content plan so the categorisation can be challenged
Keeps one topic per page and splits any page covering two unrelated topics, using slugs that match GitHub wiki URL rules
Cross links to the README instead of duplicating it in full, and adds no emoji and no AI credit line
